content.bridge_context: Understanding how plants make their own food and reproduce.

units.title: Photosynthesis
units.explanation: Plants make food using sunlight, CO2, water, and chlorophyll in leaves.
units.dual_language_instruction: What is the green pigment in leaves? / पत्तियों में हरा वर्णक (pigment) क्या है?

units.title: Reproduction in Plants
units.explanation: Sexual (through seeds/flowers) and Asexual (through roots, stems, leaves).
units.dual_language_instruction: Name a plant that grows from a stem cutting. / तने की कलम (stem cutting) से उगने वाले एक पौधे का नाम बताएं।
